description: A Java class named ThingQueryResponseSignalMapper that maps signal responses for 'thing' queries within a protocol adapter context. It extends an abstract mapper class and implements response signal mapping, performing validation, constructing topic paths, and enhancing payloads based on 'thing' query responses.

classes.name: ThingQueryResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class responsible for mapping 'thing' query response signals, extending AbstractQuerySignalMapper and implementing ResponseSignalMapper. It performs validation, constructs topic paths, and enhances payloads based on 'thing' query responses.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the response class name ends with 'Response'; throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and returns a TopicPathBuilder for the given 'thing' query response.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Adds status and entity information from the response into the PayloadBuilder.
